answer: Reaching the kernel of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The jade is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the oasis. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
